row.notes: Press-interview UI screen builder (called from FUN_141d3bf40, unnamed). With question==0 it clears the answer vector at +0x1028/+0x1030, clears flag +0x101e, sets bool nodes +0x2c0 (true) and +0xff8 (false) and dispatches a UI event. Otherwise it resolves the local player entrant id, sets VM strings interviewer_name (+0x2e0) and question_text (+0x300, localised via Career_Format_SponsorNameTokens token formatter), builds an index list of the question answers (question +0x38..+0x40), shuffles it with an MT19937 seeded from career +0x280, then for up to 4 slots (stride 0x288 at screen +0x360) creates child node answer_%i and sets text, icon, icon_valid, answer_valid, handle_input, show_lock, is_enabled, Gated, Active, Selected, Confirmed, Opening, lock_type_icon, lock_level_requirement (lng_level_requirement_0), lock_image (overrides.press_interviews.lock_icons[locked]), unlocked; answer +0x70 type 1/2 marks a gated answer compared against a stat level (answer +0x74) with icon overrides.story.social_media_narrative_icons[%s] and a LEVEL token; slot stores display index +0x280 and shuffled answer index +0x284. Unused slots get answer_valid etc cleared and index -1; ends with FUN_141d42b80(screen). Better context needed: caller FUN_141d3bf40 is unnamed and lines for the middle answer-slot blocks were only skimmed, so exact per-node offsets are partial.
